hook.en: From the bright gongs of the Malay gamelan to the gentle sape of the Orang Ulu, Malaysia's music is as diverse as its people.
hook.bm: Daripada gong gamelan Melayu yang gemersik hingga sape Orang Ulu yang lembut, muzik Malaysia sepelbagai rakyatnya.

bigIdeas.en: Peninsular ensembles include the Malay gamelan, caklempong (Negeri Sembilan) and kompang.
bigIdeas.bm: Ensembel Semenanjung termasuk gamelan Melayu, caklempong (Negeri Sembilan) dan kompang.

bigIdeas.en: Sabah and Sarawak have the kulintangan, sompoton and sape.
bigIdeas.bm: Sabah dan Sarawak mempunyai kulintangan, sompoton dan sape.

bigIdeas.en: Dikir barat and Mak Yong from Kelantan combine singing, music and performance; Mak Yong is recognised by UNESCO.
bigIdeas.bm: Dikir barat dan Mak Yong dari Kelantan menggabungkan nyanyian, muzik dan persembahan; Mak Yong diiktiraf oleh UNESCO.

cells.en: Frame drums; interlocking rhythms at weddings

cells.en: Row of small gongs on a frame
cells.bm: Deretan gong kecil di atas rangka

cells.en: Tok juara, tukang karut and chorus (awok-awok)
cells.bm: Tok juara, tukang karut dan awok-awok

definition.en: An ensemble mainly of gongs and metallophones, with drums.
definition.bm: Ensembel yang kebanyakannya terdiri daripada gong dan metalofon, bersama gendang.

definition.en: Bronze gong-chime ensemble from Negeri Sembilan.
definition.bm: Ensembel gong berderet gangsa dari Negeri Sembilan.

definition.en: The singer in dikir barat who improvises witty verses.
definition.bm: Penyanyi dalam dikir barat yang mencipta pantun spontan secara jenaka.

definition.en: The lead singer of a dikir barat group.
Kelantanese dance-drama with singing, acting and music (rebab, gendang, gong).
definition.bm: Teater tari Kelantan dengan nyanyian, lakonan dan muzik (rebab, gendang, gong).

definition.en: Music passed down by listening and imitation rather than notation.
definition.bm: Muzik yang diwarisi melalui pendengaran dan peniruan, bukan notasi.

question.en: At a Malay wedding, a group plays frame drums in interlocking patterns while the groom arrives. Which ensemble is it?
question.bm: Di majlis perkahwinan Melayu, satu kumpulan memalu gendang bingkai dengan corak berjalin semasa pengantin lelaki tiba. Ensembel apakah ini?

steps.en: Frame drums with stretched skin → membranophones.
Used to welcome the groom in a procession.
steps.bm: Digunakan untuk menyambut pengantin dalam perarakan.
